verdict.rationale: Employee onboarding and offboarding tracking is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform like Thoropass, but the evidence shows no HR-synced hire/leaver checklists, training-completion tracking, or offboarding access-removal verification. The nearest items are related but different features: periodic access reviews, 'Onboarding Mode' (which only covers setting up the admin's compliance program), and managing users' access to Thoropass itself. None of these earn credit for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
